t.zh: 行滤波器只沿着一行滑。图是二维的，上下的邻居同样有用。
t.en: The row filter slides along rows only. A picture is two-dimensional, and the neighbours above and below matter as much.

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：同一个滑动加权和，换成竖直方向该怎么接？接一块列滤波器：输入一张图和上、中、下三个权重，输出和原图一样大，图外补 0。
t.en: This level asks: how is the same sliding weighted sum wired down the columns? Wire a column filter: an image and the above, centre and below weights, an output as large as the image, 0 outside.

desc.zh: 输入一张图和上、中、下三个权重 a、b、c，输出和原图一样大：每个位置 a × 上邻 + b × 自己 + c × 下邻，图外补 0
desc.en: Takes an image and the above, centre and below weights a, b, c; gives an output as large as the image, a × above + b × here + c × below at each position, 0 outside

after.zh: 同一个<wiki-ref to="convolution"></wiki-ref>，只是邻居换成了上下：方向不同，计算一样。
after.en: The same <wiki-ref to="convolution"></wiki-ref>, the neighbours now above and below: another direction, the same computation.

brief.zh: 输入一张图和权重 a、b、c：交出每个位置 a × 上邻 + b × 自己 + c × 下邻，图外补 0。
brief.en: Given an image and the weights a, b, c, give a × above + b × here + c × below at each position, 0 outside.

hint.zh: 和行滤波器比，变的是哪个坐标？
hint.en: Compared with the row filter, which coordinate changes?
